content:
Analyzing the datasheet: one Grey QSFP28 100GBASE-SR4 block lists 70 m OM3 and 100 m OM4, 103.12 Gbps aggregate, 25.78 Gbps per lane, 100GbE, and IEEE 802.3bj RS(528,514). Ordering lists `TQ2015-M85I-SO`; `TQ2015-M85C-SO` appears in the intro—separate modes per model. Reach splits by fiber grade; line-rate mode uses 103.12 Gbps (not separate modes for 25.78 or 100.0).
